description: This file contains an asynchronous load test script for testing a Router object with S3 caching integration in the litellm library. It sets up multiple concurrent tasks to invoke the router's completion method, measures total and average response times, and uses environment configurations for model parameters.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A routing object from the litellm library for handling model API calls.

classes.name: Timeout
classes.description: A timeout exception class used for handling request timeouts.

methods.name: call_acompletion(semaphore, router: Router, input_data)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to invoke the router.acompletion method with timeout handling and semaphore control.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main asynchronous function to set up the router, create multiple concurrent tasks, and measure total and average response times.
